, the maximum weight scheduling is a good candidate for the delay sensitive wireless networks.

the maximum weight algorithm is a good choice for wireless networks with multi-hop traffic flows, as long as the number of activated wireless links in a typical schedule is of similar order as the number in the entire network.

, the maximum weight scheduling achieves order optimal delay in both single-hop and multi-hop cases if the network is sufficiently loaded, and the number of activated link in one typical schedule grows linearly with the number of links.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, under a simple condition, the maximum weight scheduling achieves order optimal performance for wireless networks with single-hop and multi-hop flows, and the delay is insensitive to the network topology.

, for wireless ad hoc network with single-hop traffic, maximum weight scheduling achieves order optimal delay under the condition that the number of activated link in a typical schedule is of order O(N).
maximum weight scheduling can achieve order optimal delay in wireless ad hoc network with multi-hop flows if the maximum number of hops of the flows is bounded.
